profile.name: erica huang
profile.bio: hi! i'm erica. i make websites that engage audiences visually and perform at scale. i work with designers, engineers, and marketers to turn ideas into meaningful products. i also make games and other cool things sometimes too.
profile.askMeAbout: ask me about my projects, work, or my love for toro inuoue!

projects.name: clubhouse
projects.tagline: a website for students to rate and review clubs at ucla.
projects.details:
Details:

Problem: UCLA students lacked a centralized, transparent way to discover and evaluate student organizations before committing their time.

Action: I led end-to-end development across the stack, including APIs, authentication, deployment, and core review features. I worked closely with design and marketing to ship iteratively and respond to user feedback.

Outcome: Launched a scalable platform used by UCLA students to browse, rate, and review clubs with plans for profiles and recommendations.

projects.name: ucla student affairs
projects.tagline: accessibility-focused web development for ucla student affairs sites.
projects.details:
Details:

Problem: Multiple UCLA Student Affairs websites needed reusable components, bug fixes, and accessibility improvements.

Action: I built reusable UI components, fixed production bugs, and implemented accessibility improvements across several sites.

Outcome: More inclusive and reliable web experiences for students navigating UCLA resources.

projects.name: michael dean wilkins
projects.tagline: a freelance portfolio site for an la-based photographer.
projects.details:
Details:

Problem: A photographer needed a performant, scalable portfolio with easy content management.

Action: I designed and built the site with a headless CMS, focusing on performance, responsive layout, and a modern visual identity.

Outcome: A client-managed photography portfolio deployed with a maintainable content workflow.

projects.name: morii
projects.tagline: a mobile app for sharing emotions and tracking mood patterns.
projects.details:
Details:

Problem: Users needed a safe social space to share emotions and understand mood patterns over time.

Action: I built backend endpoints for posts, likes, comments, and admin-authenticated block/report tools.

Outcome: Shipped social features supporting safe community interactions; available on the App Store.

playground.name: bunnyluv1
playground.tagline: my personal website with games, blog, and creative projects.
playground.details:
Details:

Problem: I wanted a home on the web that could grow with my interests - games, writing, crafts, and experiments.

Action: I built and continuously refactor the site from plain HTML/CSS/JS into Astro, adding interactive features like a tamagotchi game and a creations archive.

Outcome: A living personal site that doubles as a playground for learning new tools and design ideas.
